conclusion: Cables are noncolliding visual geometry. Transfer and probe bend selected meshes from measured mechanism joint positions, without cable dynamics or reaction loads.
limitations: No cable mass per segment, bending/torsional stiffness, axial tension, gravity sag, friction, self-contact, breakage or connector load transmission.
Native MuJoCo visual OBJ cables remain in their exported rest shape relative to their owning rigid body.
Existing hose sweeps validate sampled visual clearance only, not physical contact response.
